stem: Which sentence supports the belief that online education will be more widespread in the future?

options.label: A
options.text: Students involved in extracurricular activities, those who have been hospitalized, or those who are behind in earning required credits can meet their educational needs through enrollment in online classes.

options.label: B
options.text: U.S. Education Secretary Arne Duncan believes so strongly in virtual education that he helped budget $500 million for the development of online precollege and college courses over the next 10 years.

options.label: C
options.text: A 2009 Department of Education report suggests that students enrolled in online classes performed better than those in traditional schools.

options.label: D
options.text: This "classroom" experience is far different than anything they did in school.
